Summary: As an HR user, I want to create and maintain Person records so that people can be consistently identified across tenants and Zimasa products.
Description:
As an HR user, I want to create and maintain Person records so that people can be consistently identified across tenants and Zimasa products.

Requirements: PW-CORE-01

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I am an HR user, when I create a Person with mandatory demographic and at least one contact detail, then the system stores a new Person with a generated ID.
- Given a Person exists, when I add or update multiple contact methods and mark one as primary, then the system enforces exactly one primary per contact type.
- Given I search for a Person by name or ID, when I execute the search, then only Persons within my tenant and permission scope are returned.

Summary: As an HR user, I want to create an Employee for my tenant from an existing Person so that employment data is scoped per tenant.
Description:
As an HR user, I want to create an Employee for my tenant from an existing Person so that employment data is scoped per tenant.

Requirements: PW-CORE-02, PW-CORE-03, PW-CORE-04

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a Person exists in the directory, when I create an Employee for that Person in my tenant, then the system links the Employee to that Person and tags it with my tenant.
- Given a Person already has an Employee record in another tenant, when I create an Employee in my tenant, then the system allows a separate Employee record without exposing the other tenant.
- Given I am scoped to Tenant A, when I use Employee APIs or UI, then I cannot see Employee records from Tenant B.

Summary: As an HR user, I want to update an Employee’s employment status so that lifecycle changes like probation, suspension and exit are tracked.
Description:
As an HR user, I want to update an Employee’s employment status so that lifecycle changes like probation, suspension and exit are tracked.

Requirements: PW-CORE-02, PW-CORE-07, PW-CORE-08

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given an Employee is Active, when I change their status to Probation or Exited with an effective date and reason, then the system records the new status and appends a status history entry.
- Given an Employee has multiple status changes, when I view their status history, then I see a chronological list with old status, new status, effective date and reason.
- Given I run a joiners or leavers report for a date range, when the system processes status history, then it includes Employees whose status changed to Active or Exited in that period.

Summary: As an HR user, I want to create and update employment contracts so that contractual terms and key dates are recorded over time.
Description:
As an HR user, I want to create and update employment contracts so that contractual terms and key dates are recorded over time.

Requirements: PW-CORE-05, PW-CORE-06

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given an Employee exists, when I create a contract with type, start date, optional end date and probation end date, then the system stores the contract with the chosen status (Draft or Active).
- Given a contract is ended, when I view the Employee’s contract history, then I see all contracts with type, dates and status.
- Given a contract references a primary Position Assignment, when I save it, then the contract remains linked to that Position Assignment.

Summary: As an HR user, I want to run joiners/leavers/status change reports so that I can monitor workforce movement.
Description:
As an HR user, I want to run joiners/leavers/status change reports so that I can monitor workforce movement.

Requirements: PW-CORE-07, PW-CORE-08

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I select a date range and Joiners, when I run the report, then I see Employees whose first Active status fell within that range.
- Given I select a date range and Leavers, when I run the report, then I see Employees whose status changed to Exited within that range.
- Given I select Status changes for a period, when I run the report, then I see all status history entries in that range grouped by Employee.

Summary: As an HR user, I want to capture employee dependents so that I can determine basic wellness program eligibility.
Description:
As an HR user, I want to capture employee dependents so that I can determine basic wellness program eligibility.

Requirements: PW-CORE-09, PW-CORE-10

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given an Employee exists, when I add a dependent with relationship, date of birth and a health cover flag, then the system saves the dependent linked to that Employee.
- Given I view an Employee profile, when dependents exist, then I see a simple list of dependents with relationship, DOB and cover flag only.
- Given I export wellness eligibility data, when the export runs, then it includes Employee and basic dependent fields without full benefits structures.

Summary: As an HR user, I want to record simple education and professional qualifications so that managers have context for performance and development.
Description:
As an HR user, I want to record simple education and professional qualifications so that managers have context for performance and development.

Requirements: PW-CORE-11, PW-CORE-13

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a Person exists, when I add a qualification with type, institution, name, level and completion year, then the system stores it linked to that Person.
- Given a Person has multiple qualifications, when I view their profile, then I see a list of qualifications sorted by completion year.
- Given deep subject hierarchies are out of scope, when I record qualifications, then the UI only exposes simple summary fields.

Summary: As an HR user, I want to record prior employment history so that managers can quickly understand an employee’s background.
Description:
As an HR user, I want to record prior employment history so that managers can quickly understand an employee’s background.

Requirements: PW-CORE-12, PW-CORE-13

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a Person exists, when I add prior employment with employer, role title, start date and end date, then the system stores it linked to that Person.
- Given a Person has multiple prior employment entries, when I view them, then they are shown in chronological order with summary fields only.

Summary: As an HR or wellness admin, I want to maintain a wellness engagement profile for each employee so that wellness nudges and AI insights can be tailored.
Description:
As an HR or wellness admin, I want to maintain a wellness engagement profile for each employee so that wellness nudges and AI insights can be tailored.

Requirements: PW-CORE-14, PW-CORE-15

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given an Employee exists, when I set their consent flag, preferred channel and engagement tags, then the system stores a wellness engagement profile for that Employee.
- Given engagement tags change over time, when I view the profile, then I see the latest tags that can be used as context by AI features.
- Given an AI feature requests context, when the system assembles the context, then it can include non-clinical wellness profile fields for that Employee.

Summary: As a compliance officer, I want wellness engagement data to be protected from punitive use so that employees can trust the system.
Description:
As a compliance officer, I want wellness engagement data to be protected from punitive use so that employees can trust the system.

Requirements: PW-CORE-16

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I am building a disciplinary report, when I select filters, then wellness engagement fields are not offered as primary filters for punitive lists.
- Given an API consumer requests wellness engagement data, when documentation is generated or viewed, then it clearly states that the data is for engagement and coaching, not disciplinary automation.

Summary: As an HR admin, I want to maintain an org unit hierarchy so that departments, teams and cost centres are clearly structured.
Description:
As an HR admin, I want to maintain an org unit hierarchy so that departments, teams and cost centres are clearly structured.

Requirements: PW-ORG-01, PW-ORG-02

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I create an Org Unit without a parent, when I save it, then it becomes a top-level Org Unit in my tenant.
- Given I create an Org Unit with a parent, when I save it, then the system records the parent-child relationship and shows it in the tree.
- Given Org Units have effective from and to dates, when I view the active structure for a date, then only Org Units whose effective period covers that date are shown as active.

Summary: As an HR user, I want to define job roles so that positions and performance templates can reference consistent role definitions.
Description:
As an HR user, I want to define job roles so that positions and performance templates can reference consistent role definitions.

Requirements: PW-ORG-03, PW-ORG-04

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I create a Job Role with name, description, family and level, when I save it, then the Job Role is available for positions and templates.
- Given a Job Role is referenced by positions, when I update its description or job family, then all referencing positions remain linked to the updated role.

Summary: As an HR user, I want to capture simple job requirements for each role so that performance and development have clear context.
Description:
As an HR user, I want to capture simple job requirements for each role so that performance and development have clear context.

Requirements: PW-ORG-09, PW-ORG-10

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a Job Role exists, when I enter minimum qualification level, desired years of experience and key skills tags, then the system stores these as job requirements.
- Given job requirements exist, when a manager views an employee’s profile or appraisal, then the requirements are displayed as read-only context without being used for ATS-style matching.

Summary: As an HR admin, I want to maintain positions linked to org units and job roles so that the structure of seats in the organisation is clear.
Description:
As an HR admin, I want to maintain positions linked to org units and job roles so that the structure of seats in the organisation is clear.

Requirements: PW-ORG-05

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given an Org Unit and Job Role exist, when I create a Position with code and title and link it to them, then the Position is saved and appears under that Org Unit.
- Given Positions exist across Org Units, when I view the org chart, then positions are shown nested under their respective Org Units.

Summary: As an HR admin, I want to configure primary and optional secondary reporting lines so that matrix structures are supported.
Description:
As an HR admin, I want to configure primary and optional secondary reporting lines so that matrix structures are supported.

Requirements: PW-ORG-06

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given two Positions exist, when I set Position A’s primary reports-to as Position B, then the system enforces that only one primary reporting line exists for Position A.
- Given a primary reporting line is set, when I add a secondary reports-to Position, then the secondary relationship is stored without affecting the primary.
- Given a manager views their team, when the system builds the hierarchy, then it uses primary reporting lines to determine direct reports.

Summary: As an HR user, I want to assign an employee to a position so that we can track who occupies which seat at any given time.
Description:
As an HR user, I want to assign an employee to a position so that we can track who occupies which seat at any given time.

Requirements: PW-ORG-07

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given an Employee and Position exist, when I create a primary Position Assignment with a start date, then the system records it as the current primary assignment if no overlapping primary exists.
- Given an Employee already has a primary assignment for a period, when I attempt to create another overlapping primary assignment, then the system prevents the overlap or requires closing the previous assignment according to configuration.

Summary: As an HR user, I want to track assignment history so that transfers, promotions and secondments are visible over time.
Description:
As an HR user, I want to track assignment history so that transfers, promotions and secondments are visible over time.

Requirements: PW-ORG-08

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given an Employee has multiple Position Assignments over time, when I view their assignment history, then I see each assignment with position, org unit, primary/secondary flag, start date and end date.
- Given a manager views their current team, when the system calculates team membership, then only assignments active on today’s date are included.

Summary: As an HR admin, I want to configure leave types so that our leave policies, including wellness leave, are correctly represented.
Description:
As an HR admin, I want to configure leave types so that our leave policies, including wellness leave, are correctly represented.

Requirements: PW-LEAVE-01, PW-LEAVE-02

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I am in leave settings, when I create a Leave Type with name, category, is-paid flag, attachment requirement and wellness flag, then the Leave Type is saved for the tenant.
- Given default leave types exist, when I review them, then I can edit their attributes to match our policies.

Summary: As an HR admin, I want to configure leave accrual and caps per type so that balances are computed accurately.
Description:
As an HR admin, I want to configure leave accrual and caps per type so that balances are computed accurately.

Requirements: PW-LEAVE-02, PW-LEAVE-03

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a Leave Type exists, when I set its accrual model, days per period, max annual entitlement, carry-forward rules and pro-rata rules, then the policy is stored for that type.
- Given accrual is configured, when an accrual job runs, then the system increases eligible employees’ balances according to the policy.

Summary: As an HR admin, I want to define the active leave period so that balances are tracked within the correct year or fiscal cycle.
Description:
As an HR admin, I want to define the active leave period so that balances are tracked within the correct year or fiscal cycle.

Requirements: PW-LEAVE-04, PW-LEAVE-05

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I choose a period type and set start and end dates, when I activate the Leave Period, then it becomes the default for balance calculations.
- Given the Leave Period ends, when I trigger rollover, then the system creates a new period and applies carry-forward rules to balances.

Summary: As an HR or system admin, I want the system to maintain leave balances per employee so that usage and accruals are transparent.
Description:
As an HR or system admin, I want the system to maintain leave balances per employee so that usage and accruals are transparent.

Requirements: PW-LEAVE-06, PW-LEAVE-07, PW-LEAVE-08

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given leave policies and an active Leave Period, when the system runs accrual, then it computes opening, accrued and closing balances by employee, type and period.
- Given a leave request is approved, when it is posted to balances, then the approved days are deducted from the appropriate balance.
- Given I perform a manual balance adjustment, when I save it, then the system updates the balance and logs an auditable adjustment record.

Summary: As an employee, I want to submit leave requests with visibility of my balance so that I avoid requesting more leave than I have.
Description:
As an employee, I want to submit leave requests with visibility of my balance so that I avoid requesting more leave than I have.

Requirements: PW-LEAVE-09, PW-LEAVE-10, PW-LEAVE-11

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I open the leave request form, when I select a leave type, then my current available balance for that type is displayed.
- Given I enter start and end dates, when I submit the request, then the system validates overlaps, balance sufficiency and leave period boundaries.
- Given the requested duration exceeds my available balance, when I submit, then the system shows a clear warning or blocks submission according to configuration.

Summary: As a manager, I want to approve or decline leave requests so that I can manage my team’s time off.
Description:
As a manager, I want to approve or decline leave requests so that I can manage my team’s time off.

Requirements: PW-LEAVE-12

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I have direct reports, when they submit leave requests, then those requests appear in my approval queue.
- Given a leave request is pending my approval, when I approve it, then the system marks it as approved and updates balances and notifications as configured.
- Given a leave request is pending, when I decline it with a reason, then the system records the rejection and notifies the employee.

Summary: As an HR admin, I want to configure leave approval levels so that sensitive leave types are routed correctly.
Description:
As an HR admin, I want to configure leave approval levels so that sensitive leave types are routed correctly.

Requirements: PW-LEAVE-13

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I configure a leave type with two-level approval (manager then HR), when an employee submits that type, then the request first goes to the manager and then to HR after manager approval.
- Given I mark a wellness leave type to notify a wellness champion, when such a request is approved, then the system sends a notification to the configured wellness contact.

Summary: As a manager, I want to view a team leave calendar so that I can quickly see who is off when.
Description:
As a manager, I want to view a team leave calendar so that I can quickly see who is off when.

Requirements: PW-LEAVE-14, PW-LEAVE-15

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I have direct reports, when I open the team leave calendar, then I see approved and pending leave for my team in a calendar view.
- Given the calendar is displayed, when I apply filters by leave type, person or org unit, then only matching entries are shown.

Summary: As an HR or operations manager, I want to enforce simple roster rules so that critical teams are not understaffed.
Description:
As an HR or operations manager, I want to enforce simple roster rules so that critical teams are not understaffed.

Requirements: PW-LEAVE-16, PW-LEAVE-17, PW-LEAVE-18

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given an Org Unit exists, when I configure minimum staff on duty and/or maximum simultaneous leaves, then the system stores a roster rule for that unit.
- Given a new leave request would breach a roster rule, when a manager tries to approve it, then the system displays a warning explaining the breach.
- Given I have override permission, when I approve despite the warning, then the system allows approval and logs that a roster rule was overridden.

Summary: As an employee, I want to see my Recovery Index so that I understand whether I am taking enough rest.
Description:
As an employee, I want to see my Recovery Index so that I understand whether I am taking enough rest.

Requirements: PW-LEAVE-19, PW-LEAVE-20

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given my leave usage and entitlement, when the system computes my Recovery Index, then I get an index value and status based on configured rules.
- Given Recovery Index is computed, when I open my ESS dashboard, then I see my current index and a short explanation of its meaning.

Summary: As a manager or HR user, I want to see Recovery Index distributions so that I can identify under-rested or at-risk groups.
Description:
As a manager or HR user, I want to see Recovery Index distributions so that I can identify under-rested or at-risk groups.

Requirements: PW-LEAVE-21, PW-LEAVE-22

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given Recovery Index exists for employees, when I open the manager Recovery view, then I see the distribution of statuses (green/amber/red) for my team.
- Given I am an HR user, when I view organization Recovery, then I see Recovery summaries grouped by org unit with filters for manager, department or period.

Summary: As a platform or wellness owner, I want anonymised leave wellness signals generated so that ZHEP can drive interventions without exposing individuals.
Description:
As a platform or wellness owner, I want anonymised leave wellness signals generated so that ZHEP can drive interventions without exposing individuals.

Requirements: PW-LEAVE-23, PW-LEAVE-24

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given leave usage and Recovery data exists, when a scheduled job runs, then it produces aggregate metrics such as under-use of leave and long periods with no breaks by org unit or group.
- Given anonymisation settings per tenant, when wellness signals are sent to ZHEP, then no individually identifiable data is included where aggregation is required.

Summary: As an HR user, I want to create performance cycles so that I can structure when appraisals happen and track their status.
Description:
As an HR user, I want to create performance cycles so that I can structure when appraisals happen and track their status.

Requirements: PW-PERF-01, PW-PERF-02

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I create a performance cycle with code, name, start date, end date and status, when I save it, then the cycle is stored for the tenant.
- Given a cycle is in Planning, when I change its status to Active, then the system prevents structural changes that would break existing appraisals.
- Given a cycle is Closed, when I attempt to edit its dates, then the system blocks the edit or requires an admin override with audit.

Summary: As an HR user, I want to configure performance templates and sections so that different roles use tailored appraisal structures.
Description:
As an HR user, I want to configure performance templates and sections so that different roles use tailored appraisal structures.

Requirements: PW-PERF-03, PW-PERF-04, PW-PERF-05

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I create a template and add sections with is-scoring and weight, when I save it, then the scoring sections’ weights must sum to the configured total (for example 100%).
- Given a template is mapped to a Job Role or family, when appraisals are created for employees in that role/family, then they use that template and its sections.
- Given a section is marked non-scoring, when appraisals are created, then that section does not contribute to numeric scoring but can still be mandatory.

Summary: As an HR user, I want to configure rating bands so that overall scores can be mapped to simple labels.
Description:
As an HR user, I want to configure rating bands so that overall scores can be mapped to simple labels.

Requirements: PW-PERF-19

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I define rating bands with names and score ranges, when I save them, then ranges cannot overlap.
- Given rating bands exist, when an appraisal overall score is computed, then the system maps it to the matching band and stores that band.

Summary: As an HR user, I want to configure questions for narrative sections so that self reflection and values feedback are structured.
Description:
As an HR user, I want to configure questions for narrative sections so that self reflection and values feedback are structured.

Requirements: PW-PERF-06, PW-PERF-07

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a template section exists, when I add questions with text, help text and response type, then the system stores them under that section.
- Given a template with questions is used in a cycle, when appraisals are generated, then each appraisal includes those questions for the relevant respondents.

Summary: As an employee or manager, I want to capture answers for narrative questions so that appraisals include rich feedback from both sides.
Description:
As an employee or manager, I want to capture answers for narrative questions so that appraisals include rich feedback from both sides.

Requirements: PW-PERF-08, PW-PERF-09

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given an appraisal is in self-review, when the employee answers narrative questions, then self ratings and comments are stored per question.
- Given an appraisal is in manager-review, when the manager answers the same questions, then manager ratings and comments are stored in the same answer records.
- Given final agreed ratings are entered, when the appraisal is finalised, then the system stores final rating and comment for each question.

Summary: As a manager or employee, I want to define KPI items per appraisal so that job-specific targets are reflected in scoring.
Description:
As a manager or employee, I want to define KPI items per appraisal so that job-specific targets are reflected in scoring.

Requirements: PW-PERF-10, PW-PERF-11

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given an appraisal has a KPI section, when I add KPI items with title, description, target and weight, then the system stores them and validates the total weight.
- Given KPI ratings are entered, when section scores are computed, then the KPI section score is calculated as a weighted sum of item ratings.

Summary: As a manager or employee, I want to record OKR initiatives per appraisal so that key projects and contributions are reflected.
Description:
As a manager or employee, I want to record OKR initiatives per appraisal so that key projects and contributions are reflected.

Requirements: PW-PERF-12, PW-PERF-13

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given an appraisal has an OKR section, when I add initiatives with name, objective, role description and weight, then the system stores them and validates weight totals.
- Given ratings for initiatives are captured, when the OKR section score is computed, then it is calculated as a weighted average of initiative ratings.

Summary: As an HR user, I want the system to generate appraisals for employees in a cycle so that everyone has the correct form assigned.
Description:
As an HR user, I want the system to generate appraisals for employees in a cycle so that everyone has the correct form assigned.

Requirements: PW-PERF-14

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a cycle is Active and templates are mapped, when I trigger appraisal generation, then an appraisal is created for each in-scope employee with the correct template.
- Given new employees join mid-cycle, when I run generation for new joiners, then appraisals are created only for employees who meet the inclusion rules.

Summary: As a manager, I want to progress appraisals through workflow stages so that the cycle can be completed.
Description:
As a manager, I want to progress appraisals through workflow stages so that the cycle can be completed.

Requirements: PW-PERF-15, PW-PERF-16

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given an appraisal is in Self-Review, when the employee submits, then the status changes to Manager-Review if mandatory fields are complete.
- Given an appraisal is in Manager-Review, when the manager submits, then the status moves to HR-Review or Finalised according to configuration.
- Given an appraisal is Finalised, when a non-HR user tries to edit it, then the system blocks changes; when an HR override occurs, an audit log entry is written.

Summary: As an HR or manager, I want section and overall scores to be computed automatically so that ratings are consistent and transparent.
Description:
As an HR or manager, I want section and overall scores to be computed automatically so that ratings are consistent and transparent.

Requirements: PW-PERF-17, PW-PERF-18, PW-PERF-19

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given scoring sections have ratings, when the system calculates section scores, then it uses configured formulas to compute self, manager and final section scores.
- Given section weights are defined, when the overall score is calculated, then it is a weighted sum of final section scores.
- Given rating bands exist, when the overall score is stored, then the corresponding rating band is also stored on the appraisal.

Summary: As a manager, I want to capture growth and wellness actions at the end of an appraisal so that follow-ups are explicit.
Description:
As a manager, I want to capture growth and wellness actions at the end of an appraisal so that follow-ups are explicit.

Requirements: PW-PERF-20

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given an appraisal is nearing completion, when I open the actions section, then I can add 3–5 actions tagged as performance, learning or wellness.
- Given no action is tagged as wellness, when I attempt to finalise the appraisal, then the system warns me that at least one wellness-related action is recommended or required per configuration.

Summary: As a wellness or platform owner, I want wellness actions to be exposed to ZHEP so that they become part of the broader wellness journey.
Description:
As a wellness or platform owner, I want wellness actions to be exposed to ZHEP so that they become part of the broader wellness journey.

Requirements: PW-PERF-21, PW-INT-01

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given an appraisal has wellness-tagged actions, when the appraisal is finalised, then an event or API call is emitted including those actions for ZHEP.
- Given ZHEP integration is enabled, when the event is successfully delivered, then the actions are marked as synced in PeopleWell.

Summary: As a manager or employee, I want to record 1:1 check-ins with wellbeing scores so that we can track wellbeing trends.
Description:
As a manager or employee, I want to record 1:1 check-ins with wellbeing scores so that we can track wellbeing trends.

Requirements: PW-PERF-22

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I log a check-in, when I enter date/time, summary and numeric scores for energy, workload and stress, then the system stores the check-in linked to the employee and manager.

Summary: As a product or compliance owner, I want check-ins to feed insights but not be used directly for punitive actions so that people feel safe being honest.
Description:
As a product or compliance owner, I want check-ins to feed insights but not be used directly for punitive actions so that people feel safe being honest.

Requirements: PW-PERF-23, PW-PERF-24

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given the Manager Copilot requests wellbeing context, when the system compiles signals, then check-in trends are included as one of several inputs.
- Given someone attempts to build a punitive list using check-in scores, when reporting features are configured, then check-in fields are not available as direct filters for disciplinary lists.

Summary: As a product owner or HR user, I want the system to award points for healthy behaviours so that we can positively reinforce good patterns.
Description:
As a product owner or HR user, I want the system to award points for healthy behaviours so that we can positively reinforce good patterns.

Requirements: PW-GAME-01, PW-GAME-02

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a rule exists for completing a self-review on time, when an employee submits before the deadline, then the system creates a points transaction with the configured value.
- Given a rule exists for taking a planned multi-day break, when the leave is approved, then the system awards points according to the rule.
- Given tenant-safe rule templates, when an admin configures new rules, then only allowed, wellness-safe rule types are available.

Summary: As an employee, I want to see my level based on cumulative points so that I understand my progress in building healthy habits.
Description:
As an employee, I want to see my level based on cumulative points so that I understand my progress in building healthy habits.

Requirements: PW-GAME-03, PW-GAME-04, PW-GAME-05

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given level thresholds are defined, when my cumulative points pass a threshold, then the system updates my current level.
- Given I open my profile or dashboard, when my level is computed, then I see my current level and a short description.
- Given competitive leaderboards are out of scope, when I look for rankings by level, then no public ranking is available.

Summary: As an HR or wellness admin, I want to configure team wellness challenges so that teams are nudged towards healthy patterns.
Description:
As an HR or wellness admin, I want to configure team wellness challenges so that teams are nudged towards healthy patterns.

Requirements: PW-GAME-06

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I create a challenge like Quarter of Recovery with dates and targets, when I assign it to teams, then the system begins tracking relevant behaviours for those teams.

Summary: As a manager, I want to see my team’s challenge progress so that I know whether we are moving in the right direction.
Description:
As a manager, I want to see my team’s challenge progress so that I know whether we are moving in the right direction.

Requirements: PW-GAME-07, PW-GAME-08

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a challenge is active for my team, when I open the challenge dashboard, then I see team-level completion percentage and high-level trends.
- Given HR views challenge reporting by org unit, when they open the view, then they see aggregated completion rates and summary insights per team.

Summary: As a manager, I want to see a health stewardship scorecard so that I understand how well I support wellbeing in my team.
Description:
As a manager, I want to see a health stewardship scorecard so that I understand how well I support wellbeing in my team.

Requirements: PW-GAME-09, PW-GAME-10

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given data exists on planned breaks, check-ins and Recovery Index for my team, when the system computes my scorecard, then it shows key metrics for the selected period.
- Given scorecards are private, when I view mine, then only I and HR have access and no leaderboard of managers is available.

Summary: As an employee, I want to see wellness rings on my dashboard so that I get quick visual feedback on my habits.
Description:
As an employee, I want to see wellness rings on my dashboard so that I get quick visual feedback on my habits.

Requirements: PW-GAME-11

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given underlying metrics for leave, self-reviews and wellness actions, when I open my dashboard, then the system renders recovery, reflection and wellness indicators.

Summary: As an HR or wellness admin, I want the system to award micro-badges for positive behaviours so that employees get positive reinforcement.
Description:
As an HR or wellness admin, I want the system to award micro-badges for positive behaviours so that employees get positive reinforcement.

Requirements: PW-GAME-12

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a badge criterion is defined, when an employee meets that criterion, then the system awards the badge and optionally shows a congratulatory message.
- Given badges are awarded, when employees view their profile, then they see their earned wellness badges.

Summary: As an employee, I want to ask the Employee Copilot HR questions so that I can quickly understand policies and my own data.
Description:
As an employee, I want to ask the Employee Copilot HR questions so that I can quickly understand policies and my own data.

Requirements: PW-AI-01, PW-AI-02

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I am logged in as an employee, when I ask the copilot about my annual leave, then it responds using my current leave balance for the tenant.
- Given I ask about a specific HR policy, when the copilot responds, then it cites tenant-specific policy content and is labelled as AI-generated.
Epic Link: Employee Copilot for HR & Wellness Questions

Summary: As an employee, I want to ask the Employee Copilot wellness process questions so that I can easily access wellness programs available to me.
Description:
As an employee, I want to ask the Employee Copilot wellness process questions so that I can easily access wellness programs available to me.

Requirements: PW-AI-01, PW-AI-02

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given ZHEP wellness programs are integrated, when I ask how to access a mental health day, then the copilot explains the process and points to relevant leave types or programs using only non-clinical catalog data.
Epic Link: Employee Copilot for HR & Wellness Questions

Summary: As a manager, I want to ask the Manager Copilot about team recovery so that I can plan interventions.
Description:
As a manager, I want to ask the Manager Copilot about team recovery so that I can plan interventions.

Requirements: PW-AI-03, PW-AI-04

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I am a manager, when I ask for a summary of my team’s leave and recovery for the quarter, then the copilot returns a short narrative with key metrics and indicates the data it used.
- Given the copilot suggests actions, when I read them, then they are phrased as recommendations and no actions are taken automatically.

Summary: As a manager, I want the system to generate a draft appraisal summary so that I can save time while refining the message.
Description:
As a manager, I want the system to generate a draft appraisal summary so that I can save time while refining the message.

Requirements: PW-AI-05, PW-AI-06, PW-AI-07

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given an appraisal has sufficient content, when I request an AI summary, then the system generates and displays a draft labelled as AI-generated.
- Given I edit the draft summary, when I save it, then the stored summary matches my edited version.
- Given a draft is AI-generated, when I attempt to finalise the appraisal without review, then the system requires explicit confirmation.

Summary: As a manager, I want coaching suggestions while writing feedback so that my comments are constructive and wellbeing-friendly.
Description:
As a manager, I want coaching suggestions while writing feedback so that my comments are constructive and wellbeing-friendly.

Requirements: PW-AI-08, PW-AI-09

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I am typing feedback, when I request coaching suggestions, then the system proposes alternative phrasing that is specific and non-punitive.
- Given coaching suggestions appear, when I review them, then I can accept, modify or reject them and they remain clearly labelled as AI suggestions.

Summary: As an employee or manager, I want HR requests to be automatically categorised so that they reach the right HR person quickly.
Description:
As an employee or manager, I want HR requests to be automatically categorised so that they reach the right HR person quickly.

Requirements: PW-AI-10, PW-AI-11

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I submit an HR request with free-text description, when the request is saved, then the system classifies it into a suggested category such as leave, contract or policy.
- Given a suggested category exists, when HR reviews the request, then they can confirm or change the category before assignment.

Summary: As an HR agent, I want draft responses for common HR questions so that I can respond faster with consistent information.
Description:
As an HR agent, I want draft responses for common HR questions so that I can respond faster with consistent information.

Requirements: PW-AI-12

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a request about a standard policy, when I open it, then the system provides a draft response generated from policy documents.
- Given a draft response exists, when I send a reply, then the content sent matches my reviewed and edited version.

Summary: As an end user, I want AI outputs to be clearly labelled and rateable so that I know what is machine-generated and can flag issues.
Description:
As an end user, I want AI outputs to be clearly labelled and rateable so that I know what is machine-generated and can flag issues.

Requirements: PW-AI-13

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given any AI-generated content is displayed, when it appears, then it is clearly marked as an AI-generated suggestion or draft.
- Given I disagree with an AI output, when I click a feedback control, then the system records that the output was wrong or unhelpful.

Summary: As a security architect, I want AI prompts and context to be tenant- and role-scoped so that no cross-tenant or unauthorised data is used.
Description:
As a security architect, I want AI prompts and context to be tenant- and role-scoped so that no cross-tenant or unauthorised data is used.

Requirements: PW-AI-14, PW-AI-15

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given an AI request is made within Tenant A, when the system builds the prompt, then it includes only Tenant A data authorised for that user’s role.
- Given two tenants exist, when AI responses are generated, then no response contains combined data from both tenants.

Summary: As an employee, I want to view and update permitted personal details so that my information stays accurate without going through HR for minor changes.
Description:
As an employee, I want to view and update permitted personal details so that my information stays accurate without going through HR for minor changes.

Requirements: PW-ESS-01, PW-NFR-02

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I am logged in as an employee, when I open my profile, then I see my personal details with some fields editable and others read-only.
- Given HR has configured which fields are editable, when I attempt to change a non-editable field, then the system prevents the change and explains why.

Summary: As an employee, I want to view my employment, leave and performance history so that I have full visibility into my data.
Description:
As an employee, I want to view my employment, leave and performance history so that I have full visibility into my data.

Requirements: PW-ESS-01

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I open my employment view, when the page loads, then I see my role, org unit, manager and contract summary.
- Given I open my leave view, when it loads, then I see my current leave balances and a list of past requests with statuses.
- Given I open my performance view, when it loads, then I see my current and historical appraisals and outcomes.

Summary: As a manager, I want a single console to see my team, leave approvals and performance tasks so that I can manage people efficiently.
Description:
As a manager, I want a single console to see my team, leave approvals and performance tasks so that I can manage people efficiently.

Requirements: PW-MSS-01

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I am logged in as a manager, when I open the manager console, then I see my direct reports, pending leave approvals and active performance actions.
- Given I click on a direct report, when their mini-profile opens, then I see their role, org unit, leave summary and performance status.

Summary: As a system admin, I want the frontend to adapt to user roles so that each user only sees features they should access.
Description:
As a system admin, I want the frontend to adapt to user roles so that each user only sees features they should access.

Requirements: PW-ESS-01, PW-MSS-01, PW-NFR-02, PW-NFR-03

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a user has only the Employee role, when they log in, then they see only ESS features and not manager or HR consoles.
- Given a user has Manager and Employee roles, when they log in, then they can access both employee and manager views with correct scoping.
- Given an Exec role is configured, when an Exec logs in, then they see aggregate reports but not personal data beyond their authorisation.

Summary: As an employee, I want to see Recovery Index, wellness rings and badges in self-service so that wellness feels part of my normal work tools.
Description:
As an employee, I want to see Recovery Index, wellness rings and badges in self-service so that wellness feels part of my normal work tools.

Requirements: PW-ESS-01, PW-GAME-11, PW-GAME-12, PW-LEAVE-19, PW-LEAVE-20

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given Recovery Index and gamification data are computed, when I open my ESS dashboard, then I see recovery, reflection and wellness indicators plus any badges earned.

Summary: As a manager, I want to see team-level wellness indicators in MSS so that I can act early when rest patterns are unhealthy.
Description:
As a manager, I want to see team-level wellness indicators in MSS so that I can act early when rest patterns are unhealthy.

Requirements: PW-MSS-01, PW-LEAVE-21, PW-LEAVE-22, PW-GAME-08, PW-GAME-10

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given team Recovery Index and challenge completion data exist, when I open the team wellbeing view, then I see aggregated Recovery distribution, challenge progress and my private manager health scorecard.

Summary: As a platform engineer, I want PeopleWell to emit wellness-relevant events to ZHEP so that wellness journeys can be orchestrated centrally.
Description:
As a platform engineer, I want PeopleWell to emit wellness-relevant events to ZHEP so that wellness journeys can be orchestrated centrally.

Requirements: PW-INT-01, PW-LEAVE-23, PW-LEAVE-24, PW-PERF-21

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given an appraisal with wellness actions is finalised, when the event handler runs, then an event including those actions is sent to ZHEP according to tenant settings.
- Given leave-based wellness signals are generated, when the scheduled job runs, then aggregated under-use, over-use and no-break metrics are sent to ZHEP with required anonymisation.

Summary: As an integrations engineer, I want REST APIs for core objects so that external systems can integrate with PeopleWell.
Description:
As an integrations engineer, I want REST APIs for core objects so that external systems can integrate with PeopleWell.

Requirements: PW-INT-03, PW-NFR-06

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I have a valid tenant-scoped API token, when I call APIs for employees, org units, leave and appraisals, then I receive data only for that tenant and according to my role.
- Given an unauthorised or cross-tenant request is made, when the API is called, then the system rejects the request with an appropriate error.

Summary: As an integrations engineer, I want webhooks for key events so that downstream systems can react in near real time.
Description:
As an integrations engineer, I want webhooks for key events so that downstream systems can react in near real time.

Requirements: PW-NFR-07

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a webhook endpoint is configured, when a leave request is approved, then the system posts a structured event payload to that endpoint.
- Given the endpoint is unavailable, when the webhook call fails, then the system retries or logs the failure according to the configured policy.

Summary: As a security engineer, I want strict tenant isolation across UI, APIs and AI so that no tenant can see another tenant’s data.
Description:
As a security engineer, I want strict tenant isolation across UI, APIs and AI so that no tenant can see another tenant’s data.

Requirements: PW-NFR-01, PW-CORE-03, PW-CORE-04, PW-AI-14, PW-AI-15

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a user is associated with Tenant A, when they perform searches or list operations, then only Tenant A entities are returned.
- Given an AI call is prepared, when the system builds the prompt, then only data from the requesting tenant and authorised scope is included.

Summary: As an admin, I want to configure roles and assign them to users so that access is limited to what each role needs.
Description:
As an admin, I want to configure roles and assign them to users so that access is limited to what each role needs.

Requirements: PW-NFR-02, PW-NFR-03

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given base roles exist, when I assign Employee, Manager, HR, Admin or Exec roles to users, then those users see features consistent with their roles.
- Given manager scoping is enabled, when a manager views team data, then they see only direct or indirect reports according to the org structure.

Summary: As a compliance officer, I want key changes to be audited so that we can reconstruct critical decisions.
Description:
As a compliance officer, I want key changes to be audited so that we can reconstruct critical decisions.

Requirements: PW-NFR-04, PW-NFR-05

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a manual leave balance adjustment is made, when it is saved, then the system records who made the change, when and the before and after values.
- Given a finalised appraisal is overridden by HR, when the change is saved, then an audit log entry is written with details of the modification.

Summary: As an HR admin, I want to configure simple approval workflows for leave and performance so that processes match our organisation.
Description:
As an HR admin, I want to configure simple approval workflows for leave and performance so that processes match our organisation.

Requirements: PW-NFR-08, PW-NFR-09, PW-LEAVE-12, PW-LEAVE-13, PW-PERF-15

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I set leave approvals to Manager then HR, when employees submit leave requests, then those requests follow that sequence.
- Given I set performance workflow to Self, Manager, HR, when appraisals are generated, then they follow that sequence with matching statuses.
- Given workflows are configured via simple forms, when I update them, then I do not need advanced workflow tooling or BPMN modelling.

Summary: As an implementation consultant, I want to import core data via CSV or Excel so that tenants can be onboarded quickly.
Description:
As an implementation consultant, I want to import core data via CSV or Excel so that tenants can be onboarded quickly.

Requirements: PW-NFR-10, PW-NFR-11

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I download an import template for employees, org units or positions, when I upload a populated file, then the system validates the data and imports valid rows.
- Given some rows fail validation, when I view the import report, then I see line-level error messages that I can correct and re-upload.

Summary: As an HR or exec user, I want standard reports on headcount, leave, Recovery and gamification so that I can make data-driven decisions.
Description:
As an HR or exec user, I want standard reports on headcount, leave, Recovery and gamification so that I can make data-driven decisions.

Requirements: PW-NFR-12, PW-NFR-13, PW-LEAVE-21, PW-LEAVE-22, PW-GAME-08, PW-GAME-10

Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I open the reporting section, when I run headcount, leave usage, Recovery and gamification reports, then the system generates summaries grouped by org unit or manager as appropriate.
- Given a report is generated, when I export it, then I receive a CSV or Excel file with the same data.
